publication_panel_context.panel_box_role: manual layout annotation only; coordinates are not a reciprocal-space calibration or registration result

observations: All three source TIFF previews and all three Figure 1d diffraction panels show the same qualitative oblique two-axis reciprocal-lattice family and orientation.

The source previews contain strong fundamental reflections together with weaker interstitial reflections that are qualitatively compatible with the publication's half-integer AFD superspot assignment.

The low-temperature source preview contains visibly stronger weak interstitial reflections than the high-temperature preview, qualitatively consistent with the publication's displayed temperature-dependent diffraction behavior, but this observation is not treated as an independent label decoder.

Each lw685 publication diffraction panel occupies only about 79 by 79 rendered pixels and shows a narrow cropped reciprocal-space region, whereas each source TIFF is 2048 by 2048 and contains a much wider reciprocal-space field.
Publication rendering uses different polarity/contrast and may include crop, resize, rasterization, annotation, and other display transformations that are not yet reconstructed.

No unique defect, asymmetric reflection fingerprint, or other temperature-label-independent feature is sufficiently resolved in the lw685 panels to prove an individual source TIFF maps to one specific rendered panel without relying on the authoritative temperature order.
prohibited_inferences: Do not promote individual TIFF-to-panel identity from left-to-right temperature order alone.
Do not infer source-TIFF reciprocal pixel scale from the rendered 0.1 inverse-angstrom scale bar.
Do not infer pattern centre from the rendered panel crop.
Do not run automatic image registration, peak detection, phase indexing, analyzer tuning, or 4D-STEM comparison from this review.

next_evidence_requirement.rationale: The currently pinned lw685 rendering supports pattern-family consistency but is too coarse to establish label-independent individual source-to-panel identity or a defensible source-pixel calibration.
